name: Internet Speed Test
shortDescription: A Raycast-inspired Internet speed test dashboard for BetterTouchTool Launcher.
description: Runs macOS networkQuality and displays download/upload gauges, live throughput animation, peak graphs, latency, responsiveness, endpoint and transfer details inside BTT Launcher.
author: Community Plugin
requirements: Apple Command Line Tools if BTT asks to compile Swift plugins
installation: Restart BetterTouchTool or wait for plugin reload.
Open BTT Launcher and search for Test Internet Speed.
